acceptance_predicates.description: The verified launcher consumes the selected runtime entrypoint produced by authenticated admission.
Caller input supplies arguments only; runtime and script paths remain descriptor-bound and immutable.
Selector, manifest, runtime directory, and entrypoint identities are revalidated immediately before child execution.
Replacement, path escape, identity drift, and child-process uncertainty reject without public mutation.

definition_of_done: Exact hostile subprocess tests prove the selected runtime is consumed and identity drift is rejected.
Independent review and hosted quality/formal checks pass for one exact product revision.
Public apply, rollback, release, and Dispatch remain rejection-only; the formal model remains best-effort guidance.

inputs.description: Existing authenticated selector/runtime admission and fixed launcher seams.

outputs.description: A separately reviewable production consumer bound to the selected runtime entrypoint.

gates.description: All evidence identifies one product revision.
A separate review worker passes before merge.
No public mutation path is enabled by this AR.
